items.name: Arkadia 2022
items.information: "Arkadia 2022" será la tercera competencia del año en el país. Se tendrán protocolos de bioseguridad por pandemia y los requeridos por la WCA, para permitir la realización de competencias con el mejor ambiente posible. Deberá usarse mascarilla todo el tiempo, habrá alcohol en gel y se tomará la temperatura al registrarse. Se aceptará como máximo un acompañante por competidor. "Arkadia 2022" will be the third competition in the country this year. There will be biosecurity protocols due to the pandemia, and those required by the WCA as well, to allow a good environment while holding competitions. Use of face mask is mandatory all day, also there will be gel alcohol and temperature will be measured at the entrance. A maximum of one guest will be allowed for each competitor.

venue.name: General W. Sikorski Polish Veterans' Association Hall

items.information: Competitors get to choose which events to compete in (restrictions apply)! This will be a great opportunity to qualify for Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2022, which will take place in Toronto, July 7-10, 2022. **You may choose at most four (4) events. Registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted.** Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before online registration closes. **Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest.** Competitors over the age of 18 are encouraged to come without a guest. Competitors **must** read the [COVID-19 Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OshawaFavourites2022#18308-covid-19-safety-policy) prior to registering. Note: The schedule and additional rounds may change subject to final registration numbers.

items.name: Princeton Spring 2022

venue.name: [Princeton University](http://www.princeton.edu/)
venue.address: Frist Campus Center, Frist Ln, Princeton, NJ 08544

items.information: If you would like to be on the competitor list, please carefully note exactly when registration opens, and sign up as soon as possible. This competition has filled up very quickly in the past, so do not miss out. Please see other tabs for more information. **MINORS POLICY:** Princeton University now requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 that plans to compete must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to sign in. (Please reach out to the organizer with any issues/questions.) **COVID POLICY:** Princeton University is requiring that all visitors attest to being fully immunized against COVID-19. You are considered fully immunized after **both** of the below conditions are met: * At least 2 weeks after your second dose in a 2-dose series, such as the Pfizer or Moderna vaccines, or 2 weeks after a single-dose vaccine, such as Johnson & Johnson. * Received booster if more than 6 months since the second dose of a two-dose series or if more than 2 months since a single dose of J&J. Individuals who are not fully immunized may not enter campus buildings. The organizers also request that competitors and guests wear a mask for the duration of the competition. **GUEST POLICY:** Each competitor is allowed to bring only 1 guest. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots - we are limiting the venue to holding 150 people total.
